name: attio-prod-checklist
description: Run an evidence-based production-readiness review for an Attio integration across identity, scopes, data ownership, retries, webhooks, observability, rollback, and support. Use when preparing to enable production Attio traffic. Trigger with "Attio production checklist", "Attio go-live", or "review Attio release".

findings.excerpt: Use `Read`, `Glob`, and `Grep` to inspect auth, mappings, tests, workflows, observability, and rollback code. Use `WebFetch` only for current official Attio doc
